notes.title: Bratz: Flaunt your Fashion | Super Stylin’ Update
notes.notes:
This sizzlin’ patch update includes these cool new features: 
 Switch between Yasmin, Cloe, Jade, and Sasha while you play 
 Update your wardrobe and unlock dresses from the Stylin' Soiree 
 Make memories and save your fave snaps in your gallery 
 Explore new photo spots across Stilesville, Barcelona Beach, and Seoul Art Expo

The magazine is rockin'! 
As your followers grow, you'll have to keep up with the tech - a visit to the tech store is a must to keep your stories scorchin’.
